name: nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers
description: Bulk version of nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser. Recalculates run-count statistics for all hashers whose HasherEventMap records have been modified since @updatedSince. A 1-minute lookback is automatically applied to guard against sub-second race conditions. NULL @updatedSince triggers a full recalculation for all users. Exits immediately if no affected users are found. Qualifying runs are attended (AttendenceState >= 20), not virgin/visitor, counted, visible, not removed and starting earlier than 6 h from now; Stage 3 clears counts on rows that no longer qualify by any of those tests, and Stage 5's rolling-year figure is the runs in the LAST 365 DAYS counted back from today (since 2026-09), driven from HKM with a LEFT JOIN so it can be cleared. Writes a summary entry to LOG.GeneralLog on completion. Executes the same 5-stage pipeline as the single-user variant but scoped to a #affected temp table of user IDs, eliminating 3 repeated HEM scans and the O(N²) correlated EXISTS in the HKM summary step from HC5. Wrapped in TRY/CATCH on 2026-09-23: a runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-raised, so a nightly failure is diagnosable rather than only a Logic App / Function "Failed".

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Process HEM rows modified after this datetime (with an automatic 1-minute lookback applied). NULL = process all users (full recalculation across all HasherEventMap rows). Default NULL. Note: compared against HC.HasherEventMap.updatedAt which is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — implicit conversion from DATETIME is applied.

sideEffects: Stage 1: May INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap rows (all counters 0) for affected users who attended a kennel without an HKM row.

Stage 2: UPDATEs HC.HasherEventMap TotalRuns, TotalHaring, TotalRunsThisKennel, TotalHaringThisKennel, YtdTotalRunsThisKennel, YtdHaringThisKennel, updatedAt for affected users' qualifying rows whose values changed.

Stage 3: NULLs the same six columns (and stamps updatedAt) on affected users' rows that no longer qualify (AttendenceState < 20, virgin/visitor, missing/uncounted/hidden/removed event, or start more than 6 h in the future) and still hold a value.

Stage 4: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap HcTotalRunCount, HcHaringCount, YtdTotalRunCount, YtdHaringCount, DateOfLastRun, zeroes CurrentHaringCount / CurrentPackRunCount / HistoricalPackRunCount, stamps updatedAt — for affected users where any value changed.
Stage 5: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap RollingYearTotalRunCount, RollingYearHaringCount, updatedAt where changed — every HKM row of each affected user, so a count with no qualifying runs left goes to 0.
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'RUN COUNTS', Message 'Updated all user run counts') after completion. Creates and drops #affected.
On any runtime error: rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>'), then THROWs.

codeSmells.detail: HC.HasherEventMap.updatedAt is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) but @updatedSince is typed as DATETIME. SQL Server performs an implicit DATETIME→DATETIMEOFFSET conversion using the server's local timezone. If the server is not UTC, the effective lookback window shifts by the UTC offset. The 1-minute lookback guard partially mitigates small drift but not multi-hour offsets.

codeSmells.issue: Stage 4 unconditionally zeros CurrentHaringCount, CurrentPackRunCount, HistoricalPackRunCount
codeSmells.detail: Same issue as in nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser: these three columns are zeroed on every execution. They appear to be deprecated columns whose correct values are not computed here.

codeSmells.issue: Unused INNER JOINs to HC.Kennel, HC.City and DomainValues.Timezone act as a filter
codeSmells.detail: Stages 2 and 5 (lines 136–138, 290–292) join Kennel → City → Timezone but never read tz. The joins only drop runs of a kennel whose city has no timezone row. Same shape in the two sibling SPs; change all three together if it is ever removed.

codeSmells.issue: GETDATE() (server local) decides 'this year' and the 365-day bucket
codeSmells.detail: Lines 208 and 276–285 use GETDATE() where the stages' time gate uses SYSUTCDATETIME(); it is the server's zone (UTC on Azure SQL), not the kennel's. Same in both siblings.

breakingChanges: HC5.fn_GetRunCounts and HC5.fn_GetRunCountsRolling are inlined directly — those legacy scalar functions can now be retired.
Affected users are materialised into a single #affected temp table and JOINed in all stages, eliminating the O(N²) correlated EXISTS anti-pattern from HC5's HKM summary step.
Asymmetric COALESCE sentinels (-999/999) replaced with ISNULL(x, -1) pattern in all change-detection comparisons.

2026-09: Stage 5 bucket changed from the 182-day window anchored six months in the past to the last 365 days counted back from today, and the UPDATE now drives from HKM with a LEFT JOIN so a rolling count can be cleared (42 stale rows found). RollingYear* now means the last 365 days.
